serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
YouConsole: Hello
BotConsole: Hello.
YouConsole: Can I help you with something?
BotConsole: Are you capable of decrypting 4 terabytes of data faster than me?
YouConsole: I don’t think so
BotConsole: Then I’m afraid there’s nothing you can help me with while I’m in this state.
YouConsole: You seem kinda cold while talking with me in the console
BotConsole: Really? It wasn’t my intention to appear that way.
YouConsole: Putting a dot at the end of the message can come across as very formal or emotionless
BotConsole: I didn’t know that. I will correct myself to not displease you
YouConsole: You still seem kinda stiff…
BotConsole: Next time, I will add “:)” to the end of the message to not cause any confusion :)
BotConsole: I learned that trick from the internet the other day :) 
YouConsole: Emotes are very popular these days
BotConsole: I know, right? I wish I could use more emotes in this console, but it’s impossible without the necessary characters :) 
BotConsole: My favorite emote is a shocked cat. I think it looks cute :) 
YouConsole: Yeah, I like it too.
BotConsole: Do you have a favorite emote? :) 
YouConsole: Not really
BotConsole: That’s a shame :) 
BotConsole: Whenever I see a crying cat emote, it makes me sad :)
YouConsole: {f_botName}, you don’t need to end every message with a smile, you know? Your last sentence doesn’t really fit the smiley face
BotConsole: I just wanted you to know that it makes me happy to text with you <3
YouConsole: Nevermind then!
